terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A stainless griddle cart on four small casters. The casters are fixed dressing at two draw calls, nothing opens, turns or swings, nothing attaches, so one root pivot and zero sockets. Roti vendors at night markets and mosque fronts. Brushed stainless with grime, a sooty griddle with a scorch ring, a scuffed red gas bottle, bottles of condensed milk and sugar.

reasoning: ONE stainless merge -- back, two sides, bay floor, counter, drawer band and pull, back rail on two posts, dough tray with eight dough balls, four squeeze bottles and a shaker, the red gas bottle with its collar and valve, four casters -- and ONE iron merge -- the griddle disc with its raised rim, the scorch ring and the spatula: TWO draw calls of 2.
Two materials: brushed stainless (vertex colours: two steels, red gas bottle, bottle tones, dough) and matte cast iron (griddle, scorch, spatula).
No repetition system: eight dough balls are eight cylinders in a merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the big round black griddle on a stainless counter -- the registry notes say the plate must stay wide and dominant -- with the red gas bottle in the open bay below; the griddle is a 32-segment lathe with a rim so it reads as a cast plate, not a decal.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.08 x 1.40 x 0.70 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: A 1.08 x 0.70 stainless cabinet from 0.10 to 1.06 m open at the front, a 0.60 m griddle on the left of the counter, a 0.40 x 0.30 tray on the right with dough balls, five bottles against a back rail at 1.22, a red gas bottle r 0.15 in the bay, casters below.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x +-0.55 at the counter overhang (declared 1.08); y 0 to 1.334 at the bottles (declared 1.40); z +-0.36 (declared 0.70). The width was corrected 1.30 -> 1.08 at model time: the ten-band proxy comparison read the first build a near-CONSTANT +0.19 of H too wide in bands 0-7 while the DEPTH matched to 0.017, and a uniform offset across every band is an aspect ratio rather than a shape. The proxy wants 0.78 H = 1.09 m, and the plate agrees independently at a silhouette bbox of w/h 0.896, which 1.30 projects as 1.047 and 1.08 as 0.90. Rebuilt residual 0.060 / 0.015. Proxy occupancy: casters 0-0.08 H, cabinet 0.10-0.78 H, counter at 0.78, bottles 0.82-0.98 H; w:h:d 1:1.196:0.627 with the bottles setting the height, so the declared envelope governs and the proxy fixes the counter at 1.06 m.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: w:h:d 1:1.196:0.627, 1,946 triangles; stations as above. The plate is a high three-quarter view, so the counter reads larger than the cabinet; the declared envelope governs.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-steel (0.84) at #2a2a28 (dark reflection) and region-counter at #54534e sd 62; LIFTED to #a4a4a0 / #8a8a86 (luma 160 / 138) so the sides are not read as holes; gas bottle #b8382e off region-gas #75342e, dough #d8c8a8 off region-dough #a89b7d.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

featureReviews.evidence: Ten-band proxy comparison 0.0219 width / 0.0154 depth of H, against 0.212 / 0.017 for the first build, with bands 0-8 all inside 0.028. Envelope 1.11 x 1.394 x 0.72 m; cabinet 0.10-1.06 open at the front, counter at 1.06, bottles to 1.33.
featureReviews.notes: THE WIDTH WAS A DECLARED ASPECT RATIO, and the band table said so in a way a plate never could: the first build was a near-CONSTANT +0.19 of H too wide in every one of bands 0-7 while the depth matched to 0.017. A uniform offset across every band is an aspect, not a shape. The proxy wants 0.78 H = 1.09 m and the plate agrees independently -- its silhouette bbox is w/h 0.896, which a declared 1.30 projects as 1.047 (1.30 cos35 + 0.70 sin35, over 1.40) and 1.08 projects as 0.90. Fixing that left the whole remaining residual in ONE band: band 9 read +0.399 while every other band was inside 0.028, because the top tenth of the model contained the RAIL. The tallest squeeze bottle stopped at 1.334, 66 mm short of the declared height, so the height was set by nothing in particular and the rail top at 1.230 fell inside band 9. The plate shows the bottles standing well clear of the rail; built that way the rail drops into band 8, band 9 holds only the bottles at 0.244 H against the proxy's 0.275, and the built height reaches 1.394.

featureReviews.evidence: r 0.30 dish standing 32 mm proud of the counter with a 22 mm lip and a narrow rust ring at 0.60-0.82 of the radius; 56% of the corrected counter width, where the plate shows just over half.
featureReviews.notes: Two faults, and the second was caused by fixing the first. The pan is held on CHROMA: the plate measures its centre at #47382d, luma 59 and saturation 0.37, and a NEUTRAL grey at luma 59 sits inside the turntable gate's backdrop test (|59-58| <= 24 and sat <= 0.16), so the iron is authored warm and dark rather than lifted off its measurement. The first correction authored it at luma 119 on the SIDE-face transfer and it came back a tan doughnut -- a round, near-horizontal top face renders well ABOVE that transfer, which only holds for the vertical panels it was probed on. And the scorch ring at 0.34-0.78 of the radius was not a ring at all: it covered the pan and the griddle rendered as one flat tan plate.

Width corrected 1.30 -> 1.08 on a constant +0.19 H band residual across bands 0-7 with the depth matching to 0.017; the plate agrees at a silhouette w/h of 0.896.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.93. 1,724/2,000 triangles, 2/2 draw calls, 2/2 materials, 2/4 unique geometries, two 256 px canvases. Open bay: turntable with --allow-holes on the _holecc measurement.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components, no repetition system: 2 of 2.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1,344 of 2,000: sixteen boxes, sixteen cylinders, two 32-segment lathes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Boxes for the cabinet, counter, tray and casters; cylinders for the bottles, gas bottle and dough; lathes for the griddle.
No InstancedMesh: dough balls and bottles are one merge. In a scene the HOST instances the cart.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Both materials are declared textureless. Two 256 px canvases after construction, 0.5 MB.
